# Yulia — Professional Live-In House & Pet Sitting

> Professional long-term and extended stay live-in house and pet sitting. Attentive full-time companionship, structured daily care, and meticulous home stewardship while homeowners travel.

## Core Sitter Profile
- **Sitter Name**: Yulia
- **Profession**: Professional House & Pet Sitter
- **Presence Model**: Live-in, full-time work-from-home remote companionship (continuous presence, no long daytime absences)
- **Service Region**: California (Serving Los Altos, Los Gatos, Monte Sereno, Mountain View, San Francisco, San Jose, San Mateo, Santa Cruz, Saratoga, and Sunnyvale; available nationwide for selected extended opportunities)
- **Direct Website**: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/
- **Google Business Profile**: https://g.page/r/CSbvNNDCm1HxEBM
- **Verified Google Reviews**: https://g.page/r/CSbvNNDCm1HxEBM/review
- **TrustedHousesitters Profile**: https://www.trustedhousesitters.com/house-and-pet-sitters/united-states/california/san-francisco/l/6526245/
- **Background Verification**: Clean background check, 5-star verified homeowner reviews
- **Direct Contact / Inquiries**: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/#booking-form-section

## Services Included
1. **Full-Time Live-In Pet Companionship**:
   - Fresh feeding, hydration, and daily routine adherence matching owner instructions.
   - Daily exercise, walks, enrichment, and continuous loving companionship.
   - Brushing, coat maintenance, and strict adherence to owner house rules.
   - Frequent high-resolution photo and video updates sent directly to homeowners.
2. **Home & Property Stewardship**:
   - Lived-in home security presence (active occupancy deterrent).
   - Plant, patio, and garden care routines (houseplants, landscaping, yard).
   - Mail, package, and courier collection, trash and recycling bin management.
   - Managing scheduled home services, deliveries, and emergency coordination.
3. **Dedicated Household Care**:
   - Continuous companionship for pets accustomed to dedicated full-time presence.
   - Calm, respectful handling for shy, sensitive, or high-energy pets.
   - Plant-only and vacant property care for homes without pets.

## Rates & Stay Duration
- **Focus**: Long-term and extended stays
- **Extended Stay (30 Days)**: $999 base (~$33.30/day)
- **Extended Stay (14 Days)**: $599 base (~$42.79/day)
- **Extended Stays (60+ Days / 2+ Months)**: 10% extended stay savings
- **Custom Add-Ons**:
  - High-energy pets requiring extra active exercise: +$15/day
  - Garden management / extensive landscaping: +$10/day
- **Currency**: USD

## Coverage Areas & Locations
- **Primary Service Areas**: California, Los Altos, Los Gatos, Monte Sereno, Mountain View, San Francisco, San Jose, San Mateo, Santa Cruz, Saratoga, and Sunnyvale.

## Booking & Consultation Workflow
1. Homeowner submits trip dates and pet details via the inquiry form: https://yulia.sitterjourney.com/#booking-form-section
2. Introductory video consultation to align on routines, home care requirements, and expectations.
3. Written agreement and mutual commitment confirmation.
